slides.exact_on_image_text: The intimacy of "You remembered?" "Of course I did."
slides.visual: Aachu pauses at a small food table because Zuv has already kept the coriander off her plate. He is simply setting the plate down, not performing sweetness.

slides.exact_on_image_text: The intimacy of "You noticed?" "Of course I did."
slides.visual: Aachu has gone quiet during an ordinary evening. Zuv silently places her tea closer, made the way she likes it.

slides.exact_on_image_text: The intimacy of "You saved it?" "Of course I did."
slides.visual: One last bite remains on the plate. Zuv has clearly saved it for Aachu; she looks annoyed that this tiny thing softened her.

slides.exact_on_image_text: The intimacy of "You still know?" "Of course I do."
slides.visual: They are ordering after a long day. Zuv says her usual order before she does. Aachu gives him a small side-eye.

slides.exact_on_image_text: The intimacy of "You remembered?" "I always do."
slides.visual: A quieter final frame: Aachu holds the remembered thing while Zuv is already back to ordinary life, making the care feel habitual.
